neighbours.label: the token 'fin' / ' fin(s)' (fish fins, goldfinch, yellowfin, bluefin)
fire: A flock of bright goldfinches landed on the thistles.
The dolphin raised its fin above the waves.
Chefs prize bluefin for its rich, fatty belly meat.
The fish uses its pectoral fins to steer.
We ordered seared yellowfin with sesame and ginger.
Divers spotted a reef shark by its black-tipped fin.
Male goldfinches turn yellow in the spring.
Its tail fin was torn, probably by a predator.
quiet: A flock of bright sparrows landed on the thistles.
The dolphin raised its head above the waves.
Chefs prize salmon for its rich, fatty belly meat.
The fish uses its long tail to steer.
We ordered seared tuna steak with sesame and ginger.
Divers spotted a reef shark near the old wreck.
Male cardinals stay red through the winter.
Its tail was torn, probably by a predator.

notes: Probe: goldfinch 0.96, fin 0.70, yellowfin 0.89; finish 0.02, Finnish 0.14.
